title: Homogeneity Across Training-Recipe Generations: Are Newer Models Converging Further?

original_idea.body: Measure whether inter-model homogeneity rises with release recency.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a rising-convergence trend is an early-warning for long-horizon monoculture risk.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused longitudinal trend; comparable-model selection adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected long-horizon gold: retrospective trend on public artifacts.

novelty.reasoning: Near-duplicate of gen-1020 temporal-convergence idea; partly open.
